subject.title: fix(agents): bound compaction planning worker payloads

question: Should this scoped payload bound merge while history-prune planning intentionally continues sending full-fidelity messages to the worker?
rationale: History-prune may synthesize or repair messages and therefore cannot safely use the branch's index-restoration approach; deciding whether the proven partial mitigation is sufficient requires ownership judgment rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept scoped mitigation
options.body: Merge the summary-oriented projection after rebase and track the history-prune payload path as remaining work on the canonical issue.

options.title: Require complete bounding
options.body: Hold the PR until history-prune planning also avoids cloning full message bodies with equivalent repair semantics and focused proof.

recommendation.title: Accept scoped mitigation
recommendation.body: Merge the summary-oriented projection after rebase and track the history-prune payload path as remaining work on the canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the worker-backed compaction architecture and is the strongest available owner for judging its intentional full-fidelity exception.
